title: Every track, each marked, for a client that hides them itself
description: Fluster plays the original file with mpv, which lists every track inside it whatever the server says, and maps mpv's tracks to Jellyfin's indexes partly by order, so it needs the whole list and to be told which tracks the viewer's settings hide. POST /jellyscale/v1/items/{itemId}/playback-info is PlaybackInfo with every track listed as itself, a Hidden mark on each audio and subtitle track, and OriginalLanguage on each source. One rule on the server, so every client agrees.
acceptanceCriteria: For Babel Film and JS-119's viewer the answer lists 15 streams, none of Type Data, with Hidden true exactly at 2, 3, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 14 and false on every other audio and subtitle stream; each source has OriginalLanguage ('eng' here, '' for a film whose default audio is untagged)

Hidden is exactly what Jellyfin's route would list as a placeholder for the same request and settings: with KeepSubtitleLanguages ['deu'] it is false at 8, 9 and 13; with ShowAllTracks true, both switches off, or a request naming the track, it is false there; for a viewer with no settings it is false everywhere
A hidden text track has its DeliveryUrl, which answers 200

Everything else is PlaybackInfo's answer for the same body and query: the same decision, TranscodingUrl, DefaultAudioStreamIndex and DefaultSubtitleStreamIndex, for a direct play, a copy and a re-encode; the decisions counter rises by one per source, as PlaybackInfo's does
The same refusals as PlaybackInfo: 404 for an unknown item, 400 for a bad body, 401 with no token, and the RateLimitExceeded answer when a transcode cannot start
POST /Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo and GET /Items/{itemId} never carry a Hidden field, for any settings
The route is in compat/endpoints.yaml and the jellyscale-only list, compat/conform.yaml holds its answers to PlaybackInfo's schema, and docs/api.md documents it with the two added fields

The route lists every stored track in every mode, with a worker running, on a replica with transcoding off and with no worker alive: Hidden is exact in each, a track PlaybackInfo lists is listed the same, and one PlaybackInfo cannot deliver there is listed without a DeliveryUrl, never dropped (lead, 2026-11-16: Fluster's mpv sees every track in the file and maps them partly by order)
source: Owner decision 2 (Fluster first), 2026-11-15; Fluster's track mapping (src-tauri/src/player/tracks.rs)
notes: One route line over PlaybackInfo's handler with a different listing. A header or body flag on Jellyfin's own route was rejected: PRODUCT.md puts what goes beyond Jellyfin under the namespace. A client that re-implemented the rule would drift from the server's language comparison.
